title: The WORST things to say/do at work (harsh advice while I get ready for work lol)
description:
Are you sabotaging your career without realizing it? 

In this video, we’re breaking down the worst things you can say or do at work that could harm your professional image, relationships, or chances of success. Whether it’s careless comments, unprofessional behavior, or bad habits, we’ll help you spot these workplace mistakes before they derail your career.

 What you’ll learn:

The most damaging phrases to avoid in the workplace.
Actions that can make you look unprofessional to coworkers and managers.
Tips to improve communication, behavior, and your overall work reputation.
If you’re navigating office life or trying to climb the corporate ladder, this video is for you! Don't let small mistakes hold you back—learn how to become a workplace pro.
